title: U Mass - Cytokines Panel III - multiplex
author: Jason Kim
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.xv7fn9n
materials: Allow reagents and assay plate to come to room temperature. Gently remove well contents and wash plate 2x following the instructions listed in the Plate Washing section.
Add 25 μL of Detection Antibodies into each well. Allow the Detection Antibodies to warm to room temperature prior to addition.

steps.title: Prepare Plate and Wash
steps.instruction: Decant Wash Buffer and remove residual amounts from all wells by inverting the plate and tapping it onto absorbent towels several times.

steps.title: Add Standards and Controls
steps.instruction: Add 25 μL of each Standard or Control solution into the appropriate wells, using Assay Buffer for the 0 pg/mL standard (Background).

steps.title: Prepare Sample Wells
steps.instruction: Add 25 μL of Assay Buffer to the sample wells.

steps.title: Prepare Sample Matrix
steps.instruction: Select the appropriate matrix solution based on sample type.

substeps.instruction: Use provided Serum Matrix for serum or plasma samples.
Use proper control culture medium for tissue culture or other supernatants.

steps.title: Initial Wash and Mix
steps.instruction: Add 200 μL of Wash Buffer into each well of the plate, seal, and mix on a plate shaker for 10 minutes at room temperature (20-25°C).

steps.title: Add Diluted Samples
steps.instruction: Add 25 μL of Sample (diluted one part serum or plasma to one part Assay Buffer) into the appropriate wells.

steps.title: Add Mixed Beads
steps.instruction: Vortex the Mixing Bottle and add 25 μL of the mixed or premixed beads to each well, shaking the bottle intermittently to avoid settling.

steps.title: Overnight Incubation
steps.instruction: Seal the plate with a plate sealer, wrap with foil, and incubate with agitation on a plate shaker overnight (18~20 hours) at 4°C.

steps.title: Secondary Incubation
steps.instruction: Seal, cover with foil, and incubate with agitation on a plate shaker for 1 hour at room temperature (20~25°C). Do not aspirate after incubation.

steps.title: Add Streptavidin-Phycoerythrin
steps.instruction: Add 25 μL Streptavidin-Phycoerythrin to each well containing the 25 μL of Detection Antibodies.

steps.title: Final Incubation
steps.instruction: Seal, cover with foil, and incubate with agitation on a plate shaker for 30 minutes at room temperature (20~25°C).

steps.title: Wash Plate
steps.instruction: Gently remove well contents and wash the plate 2x following the Plate Washing procedure.

substeps.instruction: Let plate soak on magnet for 60 seconds to allow complete settling of magnetic beads.
Wash plate with 200 μL/well of Wash Buffer.
Allow beads to soak for 60 seconds, then remove Wash Buffer by aspiration.
Repeat wash steps as recommended. If using Bio-Tek ELx405, follow equipment settings.

steps.title: Resuspend Beads
steps.instruction: Add 150 μL of Sheath Fluid to all wells and resuspend the beads on a plate shaker for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Run Bioplex 200
steps.instruction: Run the plate on Bioplex 200, setting parameters for 125 µl and 75 beads per bead set.

steps.title: Analyze Data
steps.instruction: Save and analyze the Median Fluorescent Intensity (MFI) data using a 5-parameter logistic or spline curve-fitting method to calculate cytokine/chemokine concentrations.

substeps.instruction: For diluted samples, multiply the calculated concentration by the dilution factor.
